hand-written: agent 1.10.7, copied from agent-forward-idle-restart. The first connection reports the phone's frame rate limit 30 and ends after 1.5 s with `restarting: frame rate limit changed on the phone` (what the agent sends when the phone's Frame rate limit changes during a stream); the second connection (entries with `connection: 2`) reports 60. Every VP8 header carries the 1.10.7 stage times (`hms`, `wms`, `rbms`, `cnms`, `enms`, `sdms`).
